result.summary: The pedestrian environment features high-visibility continental crosswalks and wide, well-maintained sidewalks. However, the crossing distance is significant without a refuge island, and dedicated pedestrian signals are not clearly visible.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway increases pedestrian exposure to vehicle traffic during the crossing phase.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground crosswalk spanning the width of the intersecting street.

hazards.name: Lack of visible pedestrian signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian walk/don't walk signals are clearly visible to guide crossing timing.
hazards.location_in_image: Traffic signal poles at the intersection corners.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to provide a safe waiting area and reduce the unprotected crossing distance.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to improve predictability for crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and increase pedestrian visibility.

result.summary: The street features a paved sidewalk on the right side with mature tree cover, but lacks a sidewalk on the left side. Pedestrian infrastructure is minimal, consisting of a faded crosswalk in the foreground without accompanying signage or signals.

hazards.name: Faded crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The crosswalk markings in the foreground are heavily worn and difficult to see, which may lead to drivers failing to yield.

hazards.name: Missing sidewalk
hazards.description: The left side of the street lacks a paved sidewalk, creating an incomplete pedestrian network and forcing people into the street.

hazards.name: Sightline obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles and low-hanging tree branches may partially obscure pedestrians from the view of oncoming traffic.

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalk
interventions.description: Repaint the crossing with continental or ladder-style markings to increase visibility.

interventions.title: Sidewalk completion
interventions.description: Install a paved sidewalk on the left side of the street to provide safe, separated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian crossing signage
interventions.description: Add warning signs to alert drivers to the presence of a pedestrian crossing.

result.summary: The image shows a standard urban intersection with wide sidewalks, marked crosswalks, and pedestrian signals. While basic infrastructure is present, the crossing distance is significant and the sidewalk pavement shows signs of wear and patching.

hazards.name: Uneven Sidewalk Pavement
hazards.description: The sidewalk in the foreground has multiple patches and uneven surfaces that could pose a tripping hazard.

hazards.name: Unprotected Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median refuge or curb extensions to shorten the exposure time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the intersection to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade standard transverse markings to high-visibility continental markings to increase driver awareness of the crossing.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Resurface the patched and uneven sections of the sidewalk to ensure a smooth, accessible path for all users.

result.summary: The intersection is equipped with high-visibility zebra crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and well-maintained sidewalks. Large street trees provide a pleasant environment and a natural buffer, though the crossing distance remains significant without a median refuge.

hazards.name: Unprotected Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure to moving vehicles.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles receive a green light, reducing conflicts with turning traffic.
